The '''''Blue Slipper''''' was a [[Batag Skiff]], the vessel of [[Taryn Zel|Taryn]] and [[Trista Zel]]. The skiff was equipped with anti-theft systems that were not yet released on the open market. Taryn and Trista used the ''Blue Slipper'' to ferry [[Ben Skywalker]] from [[Nova Station]] to the [[Transitory Mists]].
